reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Alfred Judson: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source. Imported from CCEH tune 000625 (the melody read from 000625a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Ludwig von Beethoven's dates (1770–1827) are from our page for the tune HYMN TO JOY (content/hymns/tunes/hymn-to-joy.json); CCEH's page gives none. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1923, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000625a.nwc).
